findings.title: Case 5 must re-enter internal register*, not a new public rebind API
findings.evidence: packages/storage-node/src/internal/create-scaffold.ts:147 and packages/storage-browser/src/internal/idb-adapter.ts:973 each call register once; register bodies are packages/storage-node/src/internal/ahe-reclamation.ts:221-227 and packages/storage-browser/src/internal/ahe-reclamation.ts:293-298
findings.impact: Duplicate backend registration is not reachable from public constructors. A public re-register export or constructor change would exceed the three owners and the one-shot construction boundary.
findings.required_action: RED owner: import the existing internal register* functions in the new test/helpers and invoke them on an already-constructed real facade; keep constructors and public maintenance subpaths unchanged.

findings.title: Case 16 must pin mutation-body spans, not whole ahe-reclamation.ts files
findings.evidence: design.md case 16 / GREEN three-owner list versus reclaimClosedEpoch at packages/storage-browser/src/internal/ahe-reclamation.ts:179 and packages/storage-node/src/internal/ahe-reclamation.ts:122 in the same files as register*
findings.impact: GREEN is required to edit registration in those files. Hashing the whole owners would make the RED-passing compatibility control fail after a correct GREEN.
findings.required_action: RED owner: custody AheDurableStore, root/index exports, package manifests, classifier/receipt/reclaimClosedEpoch bodies and backend resolver getters only; treat a whole-file regex miss as a diagnostic, not a product failure.

grok.causal_red_assessment: The 16-case matrix is executable from real createBrowserAheDurableStore and createSqliteAheDurableStore. Cases 1-6 and 10-14 can fail F5B0Z_NEUTRAL_MAINTENANCE_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED after genuine backend-resolver plus store-read premises via optional lookup, not missing-import/typeof crashes. Cases 7-9 are causal: current packages/storage/src/maintenance.ts never inspects Symbol.for("@ts-drp/storage/ahe-reclamation-maintenance-v1"), so a preoccupied child import succeeds today. Cases 15-16 already pass. GREEN continuations (exact object identity, duplicate bind/register refusal, closed/poisoned codes, no extra I/O) are reachable on those same capability objects.
grok.compatibility_assessment: Three owners only. No AheDurableStore member, root export, package.json, issuance registry, Node/room caller, policy, threshold, or cleanup invocation. Backend resolvers remain module-local WeakMaps and already reject copies/proxies/memory/foreign stores; GREEN must install the same maintenance instance into the new global map without changing resolver bodies. First-bind-wins plus TypeError before local set composes with one-shot constructors: a new facade binds once, a later register* cannot replace it.
grok.scope_assessment: This is backend-neutral discovery of the existing AheReclamationMaintenance objects. bind/resolve are trusted in-process plumbing on the existing ./maintenance subpath, not a new deletion authority or facade field. Closed/poisoned refusal stays on the discovered backend objects. Parent f5b cleanup caller remains deferred.

findings.title: Focused RED/GREEN command leaves repository coverage enabled
findings.evidence: .logs/d110c-0c1f5b0z-plan-609ee4ba/design.md:138-145 specifies the only focused command without a coverage override and labels it GREEN-only; vite.config.mts:128-134 enables package-wide coverage with a 70% line threshold.
findings.impact: The 16-test focused run can report the intended 14 RED failures yet also emit an unrelated coverage-threshold failure, violating the required zero-top-level-error matrix. GREEN can likewise exit nonzero despite all 16 assertions passing, so the exact gate is not executable as frozen.
findings.required_action: Plan owner: before tests-only RED, freeze one common RED/GREEN focused command that adds `--coverage.enabled=false` (or `--no-coverage`) and explicitly applies that command to the sole RED execution as well as GREEN.

sol.causal_red_assessment: The 16 cases otherwise have reachable causal seams: namespace-based optional discovery avoids missing-export failure; genuine browser/SQLite constructors register real capabilities; fresh children isolate incompatible globals; and lifecycle continuations can exercise the existing closed/poisoned implementations. The focused command must first be corrected so coverage does not contaminate the exact 14-fail/2-pass RED.
sol.compatibility_assessment: The identity WeakMap, first-bind-wins ordering, exact-capability reuse, backend-local resolver separation, and descriptor-based fail-closed global registry compose with the constructors at storage-browser internal/idb-adapter.ts:964-975 and storage-node internal/create-scaffold.ts:136-155. The design appropriately limits protection to accidental incompatibility in a trusted process.
sol.scope_assessment: The three production owners are sufficient and bounded. The plan adds discovery only on the existing maintenance subpath, changes no ordinary facade/root/manifest/dependency, invokes no cleanup or I/O, and leaves reclamation policy, mutation bodies, lifecycle checks, schemas, limits, parent callers, and authority decisions untouched.

findings.title: Case 16 custody anchors must exclude the import block and registration bodies
findings.evidence: packages/storage-browser/src/internal/ahe-reclamation.ts:10-20 (import list GREEN must extend) and :293-299 (registration body GREEN must change); packages/storage-node/src/internal/ahe-reclamation.ts:10-20 and :221-227; retained ordering probe packages/storage-browser/tests/phase-6b-browser-scheduling-red.pw.ts:137-142 uses indexOf of 'captureAheReclamationInput(input)'
findings.impact: A whole-file or import-inclusive hash would fail in GREEN for a legal change; a new earlier occurrence of the literal 'captureAheReclamationInput(input)' in the browser file would break the retained D109e ordering probe.
findings.required_action: RED author freezes slices from 'class BrowserAheReclamationMaintenance' / 'class NodeAheReclamationMaintenance' to each class's closing brace plus whole-file hashes of storage-browser/src/maintenance.ts, storage-node/src/maintenance.ts, storage/src/index.ts, storage/src/types.ts and the three package.json files; GREEN implementer keeps the registration edit below the class and adds no new 'captureAheReclamationInput(input)' text.

findings.title: Case 5 duplicate registration must follow the discovery premise on a dedicated facade
findings.evidence: packages/storage-node/src/internal/ahe-reclamation.ts:226 and packages/storage-browser/src/internal/ahe-reclamation.ts:298 unconditionally maintenanceByStore.set(...) today; only production callers are create-scaffold.ts:147 (constructor) and idb-adapter.ts:973
findings.impact: In RED the existing registration functions silently replace the local map entry with a maintenance bound to a throwaway connection or stub lifecycle; if the duplicate call precedes the neutral comparison or shares a facade with cases 10-13, RED failures could be mis-attributed and GREEN continuations could run against the wrong object.
findings.required_action: RED author orders case 5 as: genuine facade, backend resolver check, ordinary read, neutral comparison (F5B0Z_NEUTRAL_MAINTENANCE_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED in RED), then the duplicate register attempt expecting TypeError('AHE maintenance facade is already registered') with both resolvers still returning the first object; use a facade created only for this case.

findings.title: Exact-shape compatibility rule needs a versioning note
findings.evidence: .logs/d110c-0c1f5b0z-plan-609ee4ba/design.md:32-40 ('exactly own data functions bind and resolve', incompatible slot throws at module initialization); packages/node/src/v3-live.ts:81-85 imports values from @ts-drp/storage/maintenance
findings.impact: Any future additive change to the registry record under the same v1 symbol would make mixed-version processes throw at import of @ts-drp/node/v3-live; that is the intended fail-closed behaviour but must be discoverable by the next author.
findings.required_action: GREEN implementer adds one JSDoc sentence beside the Symbol.for constant stating that any record-shape change requires a new symbol version; no behaviour change.

findings.title: Case 14 no-I/O observation should reuse the existing prototype-spy pattern
findings.evidence: Registration runs inside construction (create-scaffold.ts:147, idb-adapter.ts:973); precedent spy on DatabaseSync.prototype.prepare in tests/phase-6b-d110c-0c1f5b0d-reclamation-red.test.ts:301-317; primary-dispatch.ts:21-23 falls back to direct task when navigator.locks is absent
findings.impact: Without a concrete observer the no-I/O claim for resolution would rest on assertion text alone; construction I/O must not be counted.
findings.required_action: RED author installs spies on DatabaseSync.prototype.prepare/exec and fake-indexeddb IDBDatabase.prototype.transaction after the facade is open, asserts zero calls across bind-attempt and resolve, restores them in finally, and pins registration-body custody (no 'connection.' / '.transaction(' tokens) for the construction-time step.

fable.causal_red_assessment: Causal. Cases 1-6 and 10-14 establish real premises first (genuine SQLite facade via packages/storage-node/src/index.ts, genuine browser facade via createBrowserAheDurableStore under fake-indexeddb with precedent at tests/phase-6b-d110c-0c1f5b-integration-red.test.ts:23,55,904; existing resolvers at storage-node/src/maintenance.ts:11 and storage-browser/src/maintenance.ts:11; an ordinary read) and then fail only on the identity comparison of a safe optional lookup against the existing capability, matching the accepted f5b0d pattern rather than an import/export or typeof failure. Cases 7-9 are causal because the current module (packages/storage/src/maintenance.ts) never inspects the v1 symbol, so a preoccupied slot is ignored and import succeeds; GREEN must throw the exact TypeError without invoking an accessor or altering the descriptor, checkable in a forked child with the precedent at packages/storage-node/tests/phase-6b-ahe-reclamation-child.mjs:21-25 importing built dist. Case 6 is executable with two query-string-distinct imports of packages/storage/dist/src/maintenance.js after pnpm build:packages. Cases 15-16 are genuine controls that would fail if GREEN widened the local resolvers or touched mutation bodies. Counts 11+3+2=16 reconcile. Post-discovery lifecycle continuations (closed at ahe-reclamation.ts node:125-127 / browser:191-203, poisoned at node:128-130 / browser:204-206) are reachable only in GREEN and use existing deterministic corruption patterns.
fable.compatibility_assessment: Compatible. Only three owners change; AheDurableStore (types.ts:110-151), StoreCapabilities, root exports (storage/src/index.ts has no maintenance re-export), and all three package.json export maps stay byte-identical, and tests/phase-6b-ahe-reclamation-red.test.ts:182-193 pins those maps. No retained test hashes whole bytes of the three owners; readiness probes only require substrings that GREEN retains (reclaimClosedEpoch, resolveNodeAheReclamationMaintenance, resolveBrowserAheReclamationMaintenance, captureAheReclamationInput, runInternalPrimaryDispatch, ahe-reclamation:v1). The browser esbuild plugin's /maintenance\.ts$/ onLoad (phase-6b-ahe-reclamation-global-setup.ts:26) cannot touch the shared module because @ts-drp/storage/maintenance resolves to dist .js. The issuance registry (issuance-store/src/maintenance.ts:46-77) uses a different symbol and is untouched. Real constructors register exactly once on a fresh object (create-scaffold.ts:147 inside the constructor, idb-adapter.ts:973 after construction), so first-bind-wins never fires in production; two handles on one file remain two facades. Node already depends on @ts-drp/storage (packages/node/package.json:118) and imports values from the maintenance subpath (v3-live.ts:81-85), so the deferred parent consumer needs no dependency change. The module-init TypeError is fail-closed and bounded: the only writer of the v1 symbol will be this module, no other repo code uses that symbol, and silent fallback to a second map would be worse for a destructive-maintenance seam; hostile same-process forgery is explicitly out of scope.
fable.scope_assessment: In scope. Two exports on the existing subpath, a process-global first-bind-wins WeakMap, and registration bodies that bind the identical existing object; no authority claim, backend dependency, facade field, alternate capability, deletion policy, cleanup invocation, wire/schema, threshold or cryptography change. Parent cleanup caller, 64-writer/three-close and >=100-transition obligations remain unproved and unclaimed.
